Veterans Benefits: Maine fully exempts military retirement and survivor benefits from state income tax and offers qualifying veterans property-tax exemptions, motor-vehicle excise relief, emergency financial assistance, education and employment support, and recreation and license benefits through the Bureau of Maine Veterans' Services.

Description: Penobscot River city and regional service center with Bangor International Airport, the 101st Air Refueling Wing, a local VA outpatient clinic, and the Bangor Waterfront concert venue. It offers healthcare access, military-community ties, riverfront culture and nearby outdoor recreation; tradeoffs include cold snowy winters and a 2024 reported violent-crime rate above the Maine statewide norm.
